commit: bb19e7b (clean working tree; probes ran in an isolated copy with probe.patch applied)
tt_mb: 128 unless the run name says otherwise (R2: _tt<MB>)
caps: child-eval budget, never a wall clock: stress 2,500,000,000; m22/dec13/dec10 1,000,000,000; probe timeout 3600 s
suites: benchmark --suite quick --first-outcome --json --runs 1 --timeout 10; benchmark --suite move-order --first-outcome --json --runs 1 --timeout 30 (wall-clock timeouts; suite totals are not budget-capped)
concurrency: up to 3 probe processes in parallel; child_evals is deterministic per (FEN, config), so only wall_s is affected
baseline_gate: instrumented build, no PROBE_* env vars: stress 249,480,478 and m22 14,156,269 child evals, exact matches with the recorded baselines
notes: Censored runs (budget exhausted) report outcome draw + exit_reason BudgetExhausted; parse.py records their evals as null.
Counter evals are descendant child evals at frame exit, so per-class sums overlap across nesting; first-sweep frames never recurse, so their own == descendant evals and that share is additive.
Raw transcripts (*.json.err, driver.log, bench.log) are not committed; driver.py + probe.patch regenerate them.
